title: The kidney's first filter
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: Fluid filtered from glomerular capillaries enters Bowman's capsule before passing into the tubule. Blood cells and most large proteins normally remain in the blood.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.
objective: Explain filtration from glomerulus to capsule in this example.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: A kidney glomerulus filters blood. Where does the initial filtrate collect before entering the tubule? Fluid filtered from glomerular capillaries enters Bowman's capsule before passing into the tubule. Blood cells and most large proteins normally remain in the blood.
The diagram shows a selected step, not all structures, inputs, products or intermediate events.
